items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: The name 'Joe Jackson' is mentioned by the interviewer as someone entering the room ('How about you? Joe Jackson. All right. Just so them know who came in.'), but the interviewee does not mention any personal, professional, or historical connection to this individual.

ctx.x: One of them? My favorite number was the St. Louis Blues. Oh yeah. Oh yeah?

That high society. Yeah. Oh yeah. That sounds like good bands they had over here. Yeah, yeah. Good band. Here, I'll close this. Oh. How you do? All right. Let's see. You all in any step? No, we just started. We went in. We're about in the middle of the way. We went in. You all in here, man? I'm fine. You all won't you just? You all won't you just? You all won't you? I came back. Hey, Governor. How's you, Jack? We got fun. I'm good, man. We got good memories, man. We're down as I am. Harry, say your name. You got…

Where did you play? We played Mobile all along the coast, played at the old Great Southern Hotel. Practically every week before we went down in Gulf Coast, sometimes twice a week. Then we played Mobile a gang of times, Eureka Gordon and several other places. I forgot the names of them. You know Bunk used to play at the Great Southern Hotel.
